literal_meaning: অম্লান মুখে (without a flushed or wilted face)
figurative_meaning_en: Without hesitation or shame; boldly (often in a negative sense)
example_sentences_in_bangla: অম্লানবদনে সে মিথ্যা কথা বলে গেল।
তার অম্লানবদনে অপরাধ অস্বীকার করা সকলকে অবাক করল।
example_sentences_in_english: He lied without batting an eye.
She denied the wrongdoing shamelessly, astonishing everyone.
usage_domain: Negative contexts like lying or deceit
note: Primarily used to describe shameless or bold behavior in unethical situations, rooted in classical Bengali expressions.
